project_type: Next.js 16.2.1 App Router with Playwright E2E tests
test_framework: Playwright with chromium, tests in tests/e2e/, config auto-starts dev server with placeholder Supabase vars
verification_instructions: 1. Run npx playwright test to confirm all tests pass. 2. Run npm run build to confirm build still succeeds.
setup_instructions: npm install && npx playwright install chromium
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full network access. Dev server auto-started by Playwright config with CLIENT_ID=arsh-sandhu and placeholder Supabase creds. All tests use ?demo=true to bypass auth.
contribution_requirements: Tests use siteConfig import from ../../site.config. Demo mode ?demo=true renders hardcoded mock data. Page assertions must match actual rendered text.
key_patterns: 1. Each test file imports siteConfig from ../../site.config. 2. Tests use page.goto with ?demo=true for coach/client pages. 3. waitForLoadState('networkidle') after navigation. 4. Tests organized by flow number (F1-F24). 5. Demo mode shows mock data from src/lib/mock-data.ts and inline demo data in page components. 6. Coach pages in test use /coach?demo=true pattern, client pages use /client?demo=true pattern.
directory_structure: tests/e2e/ contains test files. src/app/ has page routes. src/lib/mock-data.ts has demo data. site.config.ts exports config with brand/coach/colors/contact/pricing/programs/aboutPlatform fields.
